answer: Demand a pulse: every head must publish a heartbeat whose phase derives from a secret seeded at onboarding plus the current epoch, so a dormant clone cannot fake the rhythm later. Only heads whose pulses arrive in order for several consecutive beats collect. Standing bends like willow: it gives under short absences but never opens to reveal a hidden bank of pre-aged credit, because bending costs a slice of stored standing that is not returned. Rewards are sealed as pearls, opaque until the epoch closes, so a farm cannot cherry-pick which clone to feed.
